Correlation(Stress Level,Quality of Sleep) < -0.2.
If Stress Level >= 7 then Quality of Sleep <= 7.
Stress Level is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.
At least 95% of Stress Level values fall within [3,8].
When present, Sleep Disorder is one of {Insomnia, Sleep Apnea}.

import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    # ASSERTION_START
    pid_numeric = pd.to_numeric(df['Person ID'], errors='coerce')
    assert df['Person ID'].notna().all()
    assert pid_numeric.notna().all()
    assert (pid_numeric > 0).all()
    assert pid_numeric.is_unique
    # ASSERTION_END

    df = df.set_index('Person ID', drop=False)

    # ASSERTION_START
    bp_series = df['Blood Pressure'].astype(str)
    pat_ok = bp_series.str.fullmatch(r'\d{2,3}/\d{2,3}')
    assert pat_ok.all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    bp_parsed = df['Blood Pressure'].str.extract(r'(\d{2,3})/(\d{2,3})')
    df['BP_Sys'] = pd.to_numeric(bp_parsed[0], errors='coerce')
    df['BP_Dia'] = pd.to_numeric(bp_parsed[1], errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['BP_Sys'].notna().all() and df['BP_Dia'].notna().all()
    assert (df['BP_Sys'] > df['BP_Dia']).all()
    assert ((df['BP_Sys'] >= 80) & (df['BP_Sys'] <= 200)).all()
    assert ((df['BP_Dia'] >= 50) & (df['BP_Dia'] <= 130)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    sys_ = df['BP_Sys']
    dia_ = df['BP_Dia']
    cond_stage2 = (sys_ >= 140) | (dia_ >= 90)
    cond_stage1 = ((sys_ >= 130) & (sys_ <= 139)) | ((dia_ >= 80) & (dia_ <= 89))
    cond_elev = ((sys_ >= 120) & (sys_ <= 129)) & (dia_ < 80)
    df['bp_stage'] = np.select([cond_stage2, cond_stage1, cond_elev], ['stage2', 'stage1', 'elevated'], default='normal')
    df['bp_risk_pts'] = np.select([cond_stage2, cond_stage1, cond_elev], [35, 20, 10], default=0)

    sleep_dur = pd.to_numeric(df['Sleep Duration'], errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert sleep_dur.notna().all()
    assert ((sleep_dur >= 3.0) & (sleep_dur <= 12.0)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    q_sleep = pd.to_numeric(df['Quality of Sleep'], errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert q_sleep.notna().all()
    assert ((q_sleep >= 1) & (q_sleep <= 10)).all()
    assert (q_sleep % 1 == 0).all()
    share_6_9 = ((q_sleep >= 6) & (q_sleep <= 9)).mean()
    assert share_6_9 >= 0.9
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    mask_sd_lt4 = sleep_dur < 4
    assert ((q_sleep <= 5) | (~mask_sd_lt4)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    corr_sd_q = sleep_dur.corr(q_sleep)
    assert pd.notna(corr_sd_q) and (corr_sd_q > 0.2)
    # ASSERTION_END

    steps = pd.to_numeric(df['Daily Steps'], errors='coerce')
    pal = pd.to_numeric(df['Physical Activity Level'], errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTION_START
    corr_steps_pal = steps.corr(pal)
    assert pd.notna(corr_steps_pal) and (corr_steps_pal > 0.4)
    assert (~((steps >= 8000) & (pal < 30))).all()
    assert (~((pal >= 90) & (steps < 8000))).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    stress = pd.to_numeric(df['Stress Level'], errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert stress.notna().all()
    assert ((stress >= 1) & (stress <= 10)).all()
    pct_3_8 = ((stress >= 3) & (stress <= 8)).mean()
    assert pct_3_8 >= 0.95
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    corr_stress_q = stress.corr(q_sleep)
    assert pd.notna(corr_stress_q) and (corr_stress_q < -0.2)
    assert ((q_sleep <= 7) | ~(stress >= 7)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    sleep_disorder = df['Sleep Disorder']

    # ASSERTION_START
    sd_nonnull = sleep_disorder.dropna()
    allowed_sd = {'Insomnia', 'Sleep Apnea'}
    assert sd_nonnull.isin(allowed_sd).all()
    sd_null_rate = sleep_disorder.isna().mean()
    assert (sd_null_rate >= 0.5) and (sd_null_rate <= 0.7)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    allowed_bmi = {'Normal', 'Normal Weight', 'Overweight', 'Obese'}
    assert df['BMI Category'].isin(allowed_bmi).all()
    share_normals = df['BMI Category'].isin({'Normal', 'Normal Weight'}).mean()
    assert share_normals >= 0.5
    # ASSERTION_END

    hr = pd.to_numeric(df['Heart Rate'], errors='coerce')

    dur_dev = (sleep_dur - 8.0).abs()
    dur_pen = np.where(dur_dev <= 1.0, 0.0, (dur_dev - 1.0) * 5.0)
    very_short_pen = np.where(sleep_dur < 4.0, 15.0, 0.0)
    q_pen = (10 - q_sleep) * 2.0
    sleep_risk = np.clip(dur_pen + very_short_pen + q_pen, 0, 35)

    step_risk = np.select([steps < 5000, (steps >= 5000) & (steps < 8000), (steps >= 8000) & (steps < 10000), steps >= 10000], [20, 10, 5, 0], default=10)
    pal_risk = np.select([pal < 30, (pal >= 30) & (pal < 60), pal >= 60], [10, 5, 0], default=5)
    activity_risk = np.clip(step_risk + pal_risk, 0, 30)

    stress_risk = np.clip((stress - 5) * 5, 0, 25)

    hr_risk = np.where((hr >= 85) & (hr < 100), 5, 0) + np.where((hr >= 100) | (hr <= 50), 10, 0)

    bmi_map = {'Normal': 0, 'Normal Weight': 0, 'Overweight': 6, 'Obese': 12}
    bmi_risk = df['BMI Category'].map(bmi_map).fillna(0)

    disorder_map = {'Insomnia': 12, 'Sleep Apnea': 15}
    disorder_risk = df['Sleep Disorder'].map(disorder_map).fillna(0)

    score_points = (
        sleep_risk * 0.25 +
        activity_risk * 0.15 +
        stress_risk * 0.20 +
        df['bp_risk_pts'] * 0.25 +
        bmi_risk * 0.05 +
        hr_risk * 0.05 +
        disorder_risk * 0.05
    )

    max_points = 0.25*35 + 0.15*30 + 0.20*25 + 0.25*35 + 0.05*12 + 0.05*10 + 0.05*15
    risk_score = np.clip((score_points / max_points) * 100.0, 0, 100)

    risk_band = np.select([risk_score >= 70, risk_score >= 40], ['High', 'Moderate'], default='Low')

    flag_bp_stage2 = df['bp_stage'] == 'stage2'
    flag_apnea = df['Sleep Disorder'].eq('Sleep Apnea')
    flag_insomnia = df['Sleep Disorder'].eq('Insomnia')
    flag_extreme_short = sleep_dur < 5
    flag_low_activity = steps < 5000
    flag_high_hr = hr >= 100

    coaching_alert = (
        (risk_score >= 70) |
        flag_bp_stage2 |
        (flag_apnea & flag_high_hr) |
        (flag_insomnia & (stress >= 8) & (q_sleep <= 6)) |
        (flag_extreme_short & (stress >= 7)) |
        (flag_low_activity & (stress >= 8))
    )

    def reasons_row(idx):
        r = []
        if risk_score.loc[idx] >= 70: r.append('high_risk_score')
        if flag_bp_stage2.loc[idx]: r.append('hypertension_stage2')
        if flag_apnea.loc[idx]: r.append('sleep_apnea')
        if flag_insomnia.loc[idx] and (stress.loc[idx] >= 8) and (q_sleep.loc[idx] <= 6): r.append('insomnia_high_stress')
        if flag_extreme_short.loc[idx]: r.append('very_short_sleep')
        if flag_low_activity.loc[idx]: r.append('low_activity')
        if flag_high_hr.loc[idx]: r.append('tachycardia')
        return '|'.join(r)

    alert_reasons = pd.Series(df.index, index=df.index).apply(reasons_row)

    out = pd.DataFrame({
        'Person ID': df['Person ID'],
        'bp_stage': df['bp_stage'],
        'sleep_risk_component': np.round(sleep_risk, 2),
        'activity_risk_component': np.round(activity_risk, 2),
        'stress_risk_component': np.round(stress_risk, 2),
        'bp_risk_component': np.round(df['bp_risk_pts'], 2),
        'bmi_risk_component': np.round(bmi_risk, 2),
        'hr_risk_component': np.round(hr_risk, 2),
        'disorder_risk_component': np.round(disorder_risk, 2),
        'wellness_risk_score': np.round(risk_score, 2),
        'risk_band': risk_band,
        'coaching_alert': coaching_alert.astype(bool),
        'alert_reasons': alert_reasons
    })

    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'nightly_wellness_risk_scores.csv')
    out.to_csv(out_path, index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    allowed_sd = {'Insomnia', 'Sleep Apnea'}
    assert sd_nonnull.isin(allowed_sd).all()
    sd_null_rate = sleep_disorder.isna().mean()
    assert (sd_null_rate >= 0.5) and (sd_null_rate <= 0.7)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    allowed_bmi = {'Normal', 'Normal Weight', 'Overweight', 'Obese'}
    assert df['BMI Category'].isin(allowed_bmi).all()
    share_normals = df['BMI Category'].isin({'Normal', 'Normal Weight'}).mean()
    assert share_normals >= 0.5
    # ASSERTION_END

    hr = pd.to_numeric(df['Heart Rate'], errors='coerce')

    dur_dev = (sleep_dur - 8.0).abs()
    dur_pen = np.where(dur_dev <= 1.0, 0.0, (dur_dev - 1.0) * 5.0)
    very_short_pen = np.where(sleep_dur < 4.0, 15.0, 0.0)
    q_pen = (10 - q_sleep) * 2.0
    sleep_risk = np.clip(dur_pen + very_short_pen + q_pen, 0, 35)

    step_risk = np.select([steps < 5000, (steps >= 5000) & (steps < 8000), (steps >= 8000) & (steps < 10000), steps >= 10000], [20, 10, 5, 0], default=10)
    pal_risk = np.select([pal < 30, (pal >= 30) & (pal < 60), pal >= 60], [10, 5, 0], default=5)
    activity_risk = np.clip(step_risk + pal_risk, 0, 30)

    stress_risk = np.clip((stress - 5) * 5, 0, 25)

    hr_risk = np.where((hr >= 85) & (hr < 100), 5, 0) + np.where((hr >= 100) | (hr <= 50), 10, 0)

    bmi_map = {'Normal': 0, 'Normal Weight': 0, 'Overweight': 6, 'Obese': 12}
    bmi_risk = df['BMI Category'].map(bmi_map).fillna(0)

    disorder_map = {'Insomnia': 12, 'Sleep Apnea': 15}
    disorder_risk = df['Sleep Disorder'].map(disorder_map).fillna(0)

    score_points = (
        sleep_risk * 0.25 +
        activity_risk * 0.15 +
        stress_risk * 0.20 +
        df['bp_risk_pts'] * 0.25 +
        bmi_risk * 0.05 +
        hr_risk * 0.05 +
        disorder_risk * 0.05
    )

    max_points = 0.25*35 + 0.15*30 + 0.20*25 + 0.25*35 + 0.05*12 + 0.05*10 + 0.05*15
    risk_score = np.clip((score_points / max_points) * 100.0, 0, 100)

    risk_band = np.select([risk_score >= 70, risk_score >= 40], ['High', 'Moderate'], default='Low')

    flag_bp_stage2 = df['bp_stage'] == 'stage2'
    flag_apnea = df['Sleep Disorder'].eq('Sleep Apnea')
    flag_insomnia = df['Sleep Disorder'].eq('Insomnia')
    flag_extreme_short = sleep_dur < 5
    flag_low_activity = steps < 5000
    flag_high_hr = hr >= 100

    coaching_alert = (
        (risk_score >= 70) |
        flag_bp_stage2 |
        (flag_apnea & flag_high_hr) |
        (flag_insomnia & (stress >= 8) & (q_sleep <= 6)) |
        (flag_extreme_short & (stress >= 7)) |
        (flag_low_activity & (stress >= 8))
    )

    def reasons_row(idx):
        r = []
        if risk_score.loc[idx] >= 70: r.append('high_risk_score')
        if flag_bp_stage2.loc[idx]: r.append('hypertension_stage2')
        if flag_apnea.loc[idx]: r.append('sleep_apnea')
        if flag_insomnia.loc[idx] and (stress.loc[idx] >= 8) and (q_sleep.loc[idx] <= 6): r.append('insomnia_high_stress')
        if flag_extreme_short.loc[idx]: r.append('very_short_sleep')
        if flag_low_activity.loc[idx]: r.append('low_activity')
        if flag_high_hr.loc[idx]: r.append('tachycardia')
        return '|'.join(r)

    alert_reasons = pd.Series(df.index, index=df.index).apply(reasons_row)

    out = pd.DataFrame({
        'Person ID': df['Person ID'],
        'bp_stage': df['bp_stage'],
        'sleep_risk_component': np.round(sleep_risk, 2),
        'activity_risk_component': np.round(activity_risk, 2),
        'stress_risk_component': np.round(stress_risk, 2),
        'bp_risk_component': np.round(df['bp_risk_pts'], 2),
        'bmi_risk_component': np.round(bmi_risk, 2),
        'hr_risk_component': np.round(hr_risk, 2),
        'disorder_risk_component': np.round(disorder_risk, 2),
        'wellness_risk_score': np.round(risk_score, 2),
        'risk_band': risk_band,
        'coaching_alert': coaching_alert.astype(bool),
        'alert_reasons': alert_reasons
    })

    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'nightly_wellness_risk_scores.csv')
    out.to_csv(out_path, index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
